title: Doesn’t hold up very well
text: Doesn’t hold up very well. Initially, I would have given this 5 stars. But after using this about 3.5 months, I took it down to 3 stars. It’s on our couch so it’s not even used daily. And it is THRASHED!! It’s totally balled up. The hem is all snarled, balled and coming undone. It’s soft and the colors are lovely but compared to other wool blankets we own (some which have been used daily on our beds for many years) this just doesn’t hold up. I would suggest spending a little bit more for a “lifetime” blanket vs. choosing this one. I’m glad I waited to review this and that I had other items to compare it to, now you don’t have to!!
